PROFILE STATEMENT 
 
Senior AI Engineer and technical advisor with close to 10 years of experience across software engineering, 
GenAI/Agentic   AI   solution   architecture,   computer   vision   and robotics   in   enterprise   and   product 
organizations.   Skilled   at   acting   as   the   technical bridge   between   engineering,   business   and   client 
stakeholders - leading technical discovery, designing and demonstrating scalable AI solutions (RAG, multi-
agent  Agentic AI  systems,  multimodal  LLMs/VLMs),  resolving  integration  challenges,  and  mentoring 
development  teams  toward  production  adoption.  Strong  communicator  able  to  translate complex  AI 
concepts for audiences ranging from engineers to business executives, with a growing focus on developer 
enablement and technology adoption. 
   
TECHNICAL SKILLS 
 
Generative AI: LLMs, VLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, LangChain, LangGraph, Hugging Face, OpenAI, Multimodal 
Models, Prompt Engineering, Model Evaluation (DeepEval, RAGAS), vLLM, GPU inferencing 
AI/ML/DL: PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, Scikit-learn, Computer vision, NLP, Time-Series Analysis 
Backend & Cloud Engineering: Python, FastAPI, Flask, REST APIs, Pydantic, Asynchronous Programming, 
Microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, CI/CD, Git, Linux 
Data & Retrieval: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Vector Databases, Databricks, Delta Lake 
Partner & Technical Enablement: Technical discovery, solution architecture walkthroughs, proof-of-
concept delivery, developer mentoring, cross-functional stakeholder communication (engineering to 
executive), production-readiness guidance 
 
 
NON-TECHNICAL SKILLS   
 
Leadership, Communication, Time Management, Event Management, Teamwork.  
 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

• Established   reusable   platform   capabilities   including   Pydantic   output   contracts,   model-
provider abstraction, embedding caches, retry policies and fallback execution paths. 
 
2. Multi-modal AI for Engineering Drawing Automation

• Mentored  developers  and  reviewed  technical  designs,  implementation  approaches  and  AI 
workflow quality.

## RecallZero — GenAI-Powered Automotive Post-Market Surveillance
**Hackathon Project | Client POC**

Architected and developed an evidence-first automotive safety surveillance platform to identify emerging defect patterns from unstructured NHTSA consumer complaints before they become obvious through conventional recall monitoring.

- Built a **GenAI event-normalization pipeline using NVIDIA Nemotron NIM and NVIDIA embeddings** to transform noisy customer narratives such as “vehicle suddenly died while driving” into structured engineering failure events, severity indicators, and semantic signatures.
- Designed **semantic clustering and failure-lineage detection** to consolidate differently worded complaints into common engineering patterns across vehicle systems, model years, and failure mechanisms.
- Implemented an explainable safety-signal pipeline combining **trend, persistence, evidence volume, severity, affected breadth, and historical recall coverage**, with traceability from risk factors back to individual NHTSA ODI complaints.
- Developed a **Time Machine historical-replay framework** that freezes the detector at a historical cutoff, hides future recall information, replays only information available at that date, and reveals the eventual outcome afterward to prevent future-information leakage.
- Established a reproducible validation framework using **detector freezes, benchmark locks, positive/control cohorts, temporal snapshots, provenance hashes, anti-leakage checks, and alert-burden metrics**.
- Validated the detector on historical positive and control cases and used failed generalization results to identify weaknesses in hand-tuned scoring rather than optimizing the POC to a single successful demonstration.
- Designed the next-generation **AutoResearch / Detector Discovery architecture** combining statistical surveillance methods such as PRR/ROR, Bayesian shrinkage, EWMA/CUSUM and change-point detection with learned ranking, temporal validation, and deterministic false-alert policies.
- Constrained GenAI agents to **evidence investigation, semantic adjudication, diagnostics, and engineering-brief generation**, keeping statistical detection and alert decisions measurable and auditable.
- Extended the POC toward multi-vehicle/manufacturer analysis and integration with engineering workflows through an **Action Center, investigator agent, engineering briefs, and proactive alert integrations**.

**Core concepts:** Generative AI, NVIDIA NIM, embeddings, semantic clustering, post-market surveillance, anomaly detection, temporal validation, explainable AI, agentic AI, statistical signal detection, MLOps/model governance, safety-critical AI.
